name: BOUQUETS & BASKETS
subtitle: Flowers with a Personal Touch
description: Whether you prefer a look that is classic and traditional, modern and trendy, soft and romantic or unusual and offbeat, at BOUQUETS & BASKETS, we customize designs with you in mind! We're a local Elberta, AL florist delivering courteous, professional service and the highest quality floral and gift items around. Our experienced designers can create floral designs that will complement any occasion and meet your budget and style expectations as well. We offer daily delivery service to all local funeral homes and hospitals. When it's time to shop for a gift for any occasion, choose from our nice selection of green and blooming plants, dish gardens, Fruit and gourmet snack baskets, gift baskets, baby gifts, candy, cards, home decor, scented candles, silk flowers, plush stuffed animals and more. Call or stop by our shop to check them out! When it's time to send funeral flowers, you can always depend on us to help you with ordering flowers after a friend or loved one passes away. We will design and deliver flowers that beautifully convey your expressions of sympathy and serve as a lovely tribute to the deceased. For added convenience, we offer daily delivery to all local funeral homes. When it's time to plan a wedding, party or event, our beautiful selection of high-quality flowers and eye-catching design styles are guaranteed to bring rave reviews on your wedding day or at any festive occasion - large or small. Call (251) 962-4141 in advance to schedule your consultation. Thank you for visiting our website for fresh flower delivery from your local Elberta florist and easy online ordering. We look forward to serving you!
